terms: fal.ai model output; speridlabs/idol/max lists commercial use as supported. Generated for this project; no third-party likeness, brand or logo requested.

steps.prompt: A glossy collectible power-up charm: an upright six-sided crest shield in sky-blue enamel with a raised polished gold bezel frame and a translucent pale-blue glass chevron raised in the centre. Photograph of a real glossy designer vinyl art-toy collectible, smooth sculpted soft-vinyl and lacquered resin surfaces, saturated candy paint colours with real paint drips, crisp studio product lighting, high detail. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
